title: Formalize PRD review SLA and handoff contracts
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Set a concise, enforceable SLA and handoff contract for PRD reviews that clarifies expected response latencies, decision owners, escalation lanes, and artifact requirements across Eng/Design/Legal. Goal is to reduce review churn and late-scope changes during execution windows for Dedicated and Private product initiatives.
background: Recent launches showed repeated PRD iterations after engineering sprints started: design signoffs delayed, legal redlines late in the cycle, and engineering scope drift. That led to two rollback events and a one-week delay on the last Dedicated autoscale pilot. Teams lack a single source-of-truth for required review artifacts and timelines.
goals: Define nominal review SLAs for initial PRD review and follow-up clarifications (e.g., 3 business days initial, 5 business days for substantive legal review)
Create a standardized PRD Handoff Checklist (design mocks, acceptance criteria, dataflow diagram, privacy & KMS notes)
Assign explicit decision owner roles for each review lane and a lightweight escalation path
Publish an ops playbook and automation templates (PR labels, checklist, calendar invites) to enforce the flow
acceptance_criteria: A one-page PRD Handoff Checklist template is stored in Confluence and referenced in all new PRD templates
SLAs documented and agreed by Eng/Design/Legal leadership (signoff thread in Confluence)
Automation: PR template includes required labels and triggers an initial review due-date (3bd) in Linear
Pilot run: apply contract to 3 upcoming PRDs; measure review latency and number of post-handoff scope changes
Rollout plan and retro scheduled; less than 20% of PRDs require scope rework after initial signoff in pilot
stakeholders: Design: Mx. Priya Desai (visual & UX signoff)
notes_and_updates: 2026-03-01: Created ticket and shared initial scope with Eng/Design/Legal. Asked for SLA suggestions.
2026-03-03: Design working group proposed required assets list; added visual acceptance mock requirement.
2026-03-05: Legal requested separate 'privacy checklist' to be embedded in handoff template (added to artifacts).
2026-03-08: Engineering scoped automation work (Linear template + GitHub webhook) at 3 points of effort (ENG-19120 dependency).

2026-03-10: Leadership sync: agreed on pilot cohort (3 PRDs: dedicated-autoscale, private-upgrade, structured-output-v2). Assigned decision owners. Updated acceptance criteria to include measurement targets.
risks_mitigations: Risk: Teams ignore the SLA and continue ad-hoc review scheduling. Mitigation: require checklist completion in PR template and make signoff gate part of PR checklist in Linear.
Risk: Legal turnaround takes longer for high-risk features. Mitigation: pre-allocated legal office hours and a 'fast-track' checkbox for urgent security fixes.
Risk: Automation delays. Mitigation: manual fallback process (calendar invites + explicit reviewers) until automation is live.
Risk: Measurement noise. Mitigation: define clear metrics (days to initial review, number of scope reworks) and baseline before pilot
